integrity: Analytical argument and independently executable standard-library checker provided; numerical experiments corroborate but do not establish the limit theorems. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Independent uniform segment directions, direction-independent positive lengths with finite second moment; fourth moments required for finite-size variance. The fixed-unit-length spectral series is prior knowledge; only the radial universality, exact radial variance/covariance, joint decoupling and critical crossover are assessed as the contribution. Priority of the combined statement remains provisional.
title: Universal radial fluctuations and a sharp Gaussian crossover for random zonogon area
